title: Everyday people: first 3D models (casual woman, older man, apron worker)
question: These are real rigged 3D models, not pictures: background people for the island who are still code-built placeholders. The casual woman and the older man would walk the paths and plazas; the apron worker would stand at shop and canteen counters. Each was made from the source picture you approved in crowd-everyday-1, twice, with the same Meshy settings, rig, walk, run, sit and idle as the office pair A and B now in the game. Which ones should go in? Pick any; after your pick Codex puts the picked ones in the game. Nothing is in the game yet.

options.label: casual-1
options.note: Shape roll 1. Clean face, bob and sweatshirt read as the picture. No faults found in the turn, walk or sit. 1,107 triangles (A has 1,114, B 1,099). Source picture casual-01. Meshy image-to-3D: meshy-t2 smart topology, 1,050 polygons, A-pose, no texture (5 credits); Meshy retexture styled from the source picture: meshy-7, our face-first UVs kept, 2k, no PBR (the settings that made the selected a-image and b-image) (10); Meshy auto-rig at 1.1 m with its walk and run (5); Chair_Sit_Idle_F (3).

options.label: casual-2
options.note: Shape roll 2: fuller bob, the hair lower on the cheeks. A small pale fleck where the hair meets the cheek, visible when she turns. 1,124 triangles (A has 1,114, B 1,099). Source picture casual-01. Meshy image-to-3D: meshy-t2 smart topology, 1,050 polygons, A-pose, no texture (5 credits); Meshy retexture styled from the source picture: meshy-7, our face-first UVs kept, 2k, no PBR (the settings that made the selected a-image and b-image) (10); Meshy auto-rig at 1.1 m with its walk and run (5); Chair_Sit_Idle_F (3).

options.note: Shape roll 2: rounder head, the same face paint. No faults found in the turn, walk or sit. 1,091 triangles (A has 1,114, B 1,099). Source picture older-01. Meshy image-to-3D: meshy-t2 smart topology, 1,050 polygons, A-pose, no texture (5 credits); Meshy retexture styled from the source picture: meshy-7, our face-first UVs kept, 2k, no PBR (the settings that made the selected a-image and b-image) (10); Meshy auto-rig at 1.1 m with its walk and run (5); Chair_Sit_Idle_F (3).

options.label: service-1
options.note: Shape roll 1. Clean face and apron from the front. Fault: a skin-coloured patch on his back between the apron straps (from behind). 1,121 triangles (A has 1,114, B 1,099). Source picture service-01. Meshy image-to-3D: meshy-t2 smart topology, 1,050 polygons, A-pose, no texture (5 credits); Meshy retexture styled from the source picture: meshy-7, our face-first UVs kept, 2k, no PBR (the settings that made the selected a-image and b-image) (10); Meshy auto-rig at 1.1 m with its walk and run (5); Chair_Sit_Idle_F (3).

options.label: service-2
options.note: Shape roll 2. Faults: Meshy made his eyes as two loose pieces in front of the face (the round-1 office man problem), so the face got almost no texture space; white smears on the apron bib; in the idle his arms stick out forward and twist. The walk is fine. 1,073 triangles (A has 1,114, B 1,099). Source picture service-01. Meshy image-to-3D: meshy-t2 smart topology, 1,050 polygons, A-pose, no texture (5 credits); Meshy retexture styled from the source picture: meshy-7, our face-first UVs kept, 2k, no PBR (the settings that made the selected a-image and b-image) (10); Meshy auto-rig at 1.1 m with its walk and run (5); Chair_Sit_Idle_F (3).
